title: DepWareTrans: Dependency-Aware Incremental Repository Migration across Co-executable Languages
abstract: arXiv:2608.14128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repository-level code translation is critical for modernizing legacy systems, yet existing approaches based on large language models (LLMs) operate at the file level and fail to scale to codebases with complex inter-file dependencies. This limitation is evident in our industrial setting, where we aim to migrate a production repository (STAR) from Java to Kotlin, but file-level approaches produce fragmented results and fail to achieve end-to-end correctness. In this paper, we show that the primary cause of failure at the repository level is dependency inconsistency. Through an empirical study on open-source and industrial systems, we find that most errors arise from unresolved cross-file dependencies that cannot be effectively addressed by iterative feedback alone. tldr: 本文提出一种依赖感知的增量式仓库迁移框架，通过将翻译单元从文件级提升到依赖一致的批次，解决了跨文件依赖不一致导致的仓库级代码翻译失败问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dependency-aware incremental repository migration framework that elevates translation units from individual files to dependency-consistent batches, addressing dependency inconsistency failures in repository-level code translation.
